baron_von_slick: On Day 10, Isidor "Doc" Slick arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.

Isidor "Doc" Slick got a letter from Rosa. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Isidor "Doc" Slick did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Isidor "Doc" Slick wrote back to Rosa and tore it up three times. The fourth version says almost nothing, which is how he knows it is the right one.
A bullet went through Isidor "Doc" Slick's sleeve at T-F20 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Emil Sully of the Concord (@cameron_sully).

Wiring party. Isidor "Doc" Slick held the coil while two others pulled. Twenty yards of new wire at T-F20, and everyone came back. Isidor "Doc" Slick's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
No post for Isidor "Doc" Slick this week. He checks the sack anyway, every day, and pretends he was only looking for tobacco.
dark_patience___: The old hands of U-F10 have been here since Day 1. Isidor Patience has been here since Day 10. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.

Isidor Patience gave Albin Ilhanrae the last match in the trench. Albin used it to light a candle so that Isidor could finish a letter. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Isidor Patience kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
On sentry duty Isidor Patience watched the wire for six hours. Twice he thought the wire watched back.
At the Chalk Pits, Isidor Patience of the Concord and Gideon "Doc" Midnight of the Hegemony spent the morning shooting at the same loose sheet of metal. The sheet kept winning.
Isidor Patience and Oskar Reynolds both swear they saw a ghost at Verdel Ridge. Each says the other screamed first.
Isidor Patience fired at the sound of digging across the wire. The digging stopped. Hugo "Mud" Rambam was grazed.
datoneperson01: Benedikt Datoneperson came up the line with a rosary of rough beads and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.

Konrad "Crow" Kagr (Concord) threw a loaf of bread into the Hegemony trench at the Brickworks. An hour later a sausage came back with a note from Benedikt Datoneperson: 'Fair trade.' A letter from home found Benedikt Datoneperson before the night shift. Benedikt Datoneperson folded it small and kept it close. Orders came through: Benedikt Datoneperson is a chaplain now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a rosary of rough beads.

Benedikt Datoneperson came back from the raid with mud to the eyebrows and an enemy helmet as a souvenir. The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Benedikt Datoneperson did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again. A letter from home found Benedikt Datoneperson before the night shift. Benedikt Datoneperson folded it small and kept it close.

Benedikt Datoneperson held a service beside a ration store. The men sang quietly so the sleepers behind the wall could rest. A letter from home found Benedikt Datoneperson before the night shift. Benedikt Datoneperson folded it small and kept it close. The clerk counted the names twice. Benedikt Datoneperson is number 509 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Benedikt Datoneperson walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Benedikt Datoneperson saw a hare run the whole length of no man's land and nobody on either side fired at it. A letter from home found Benedikt Datoneperson before the night shift. Benedikt Datoneperson folded it small and kept it close.

A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Benedikt Datoneperson. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer. A letter from home found Benedikt Datoneperson before the night shift. Benedikt Datoneperson folded it small and kept it close.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Benedikt Datoneperson tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at R-S14 is up. A bullet grazed Benedikt Datoneperson's ribs at R-S14. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Silas Tadzyman of the Concord (@tadzyman).

The medic looked at Benedikt Datoneperson's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to R-S14. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows. A letter from home found Benedikt Datoneperson before the night shift. Benedikt Datoneperson folded it small and kept it close.
dependentkink_____: Cyril "Hollow" Dependentkin arrived at R-F4 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest. The transfer made Cyril "Hollow" Dependentkin a runner. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.

A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-F4 and grazed Cyril "Hollow" Dependentkin's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Quentin Joshgentile of the Concord (@joshgentile80). Mail came up the line with a letter for Cyril "Hollow" Dependentkin. Cyril "Hollow" Dependentkin read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The wound Cyril "Hollow" Dependentkin shrugged off has gone the wrong colour. He is not shrugging any more. Mail came up the line with a letter for Cyril "Hollow" Dependentkin. Cyril "Hollow" Dependentkin read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Cyril "Hollow" Dependentkin helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Every bed was taken and every medic was busy. Cyril "Hollow" Dependentkin died waiting. The men at R-F4 have not stopped talking about it.

Dietrich Dependentkin came to the front because his cousin Cyril "Hollow" Dependentkin never came home. He carries a letter he never sent. Dietrich Dependentkin transferred to the runners. The men in R-F4 said they would miss him. He is only three dugouts away.

Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Dietrich Dependentkin read a theatre review while peeling supper. Mail came up the line with a letter for Dietrich Dependentkin. Dietrich Dependentkin read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Dietrich Dependentkin lost a boot in the trench. Florian Wubbarn found it, stuffed it with dry socks, and gave it back without a word. Mail came up the line with a letter for Dietrich Dependentkin. Dietrich Dependentkin read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Dietrich Dependentkin found a photograph in the mud of no man's land: a wedding party, and a name on the back that is not from his side of the wire. Mail came up the line with a letter for Dietrich Dependentkin. Dietrich Dependentkin read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Dietrich Dependentkin jumped into the Concord trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Edmund Bjl. The Concord medics will be busy. (@bjl710) The Concord raiders were in and out in two minutes. At R-F4 they left Dietrich Dependentkin behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Viktor "Button" Chasserant of the Concord (@axel_chasserant).
Jakub "Smokes" Dependentkin put a letter he never sent beside the bunk. Someone who had known Dietrich Dependentkin helped clear the shelf without saying why.

Jakub "Smokes" Dependentkin wrote a letter for Florian Wubbarn's mother, because Florian could not find the words. Florian signed it. Mail came up the line with a letter for Jakub "Smokes" Dependentkin. Jakub "Smokes" Dependentkin read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The new duty roster listed Jakub "Smokes" Dependentkin as a machine gunner. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down. Jakub "Smokes" Dependentkin got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 259. The men who came later will ask about it. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Jakub "Smokes" Dependentkin folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Jakub "Smokes" Dependentkin aimed a step ahead and fired: Bram Briton, grazed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Jakub "Smokes" Dependentkin. Jakub "Smokes" Dependentkin read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Brass cases piled up around Jakub "Smokes" Dependentkin's boots at R-F4. Out of all those rounds, one found Casimir "Mud" Kjoj, grazed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Jakub "Smokes" Dependentkin. Jakub "Smokes" Dependentkin read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Jakub "Smokes" Dependentkin waited for that to change. When it did, Pavel "Ghost" Echoss was badly wounded. Mail came up the line with a letter for Jakub "Smokes" Dependentkin. Jakub "Smokes" Dependentkin read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Jakub "Smokes" Dependentkin was halfway through a story when his listener fell asleep. He counted that as a success. Mail came up the line with a letter for Jakub "Smokes" Dependentkin. Jakub "Smokes" Dependentkin read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
fwtx_p4y0n: Leopold Fwtx, a schoolteacher from Dunmarrow, was sent forward on Day 5 to fill a gap in S-F1. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.

Leopold Fwtx crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at S-F1 holds again. A letter from home found Leopold Fwtx before the night shift. Leopold Fwtx folded it small and kept it close. Word came down the line: Hill 304 is ours. Leopold Fwtx shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Leopold Fwtx fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Quentin Underthrone, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything.
Leopold Fwtx watched fog gather on the wire until every strand carried beads of water. The sentry beside him called it expensive fencing.

A supply man offered Leopold Fwtx a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records. A letter from home found Leopold Fwtx before the night shift. Leopold Fwtx folded it small and kept it close.

Leopold Fwtx put a flat stone under a short table leg. Supper stopped sliding toward the corporal. A letter from home found Leopold Fwtx before the night shift. Leopold Fwtx folded it small and kept it close.

On the way back from the night raid a flare went up. Leopold Fwtx was caught in the open and hit before reaching the wire. The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Leopold Fwtx helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly. A letter from home found Leopold Fwtx before the night shift. Leopold Fwtx folded it small and kept it close.

Three days with a bandage, and Leopold Fwtx is back at S-F1. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him. The clerk counted the names twice. Leopold Fwtx is number 325 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill has been won. Leopold Fwtx listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Leopold Fwtx coaxed the gramophone into turning. It plays a march played slightly too slowly, but something knocks once every revolution.
Cyril "Ghost" Kkrogheemil and Leopold Fwtx sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour.
Cyril "Ghost" Kkrogheemil kept watch so that Leopold Fwtx could sleep. Then Leopold kept watch so that Ghost could. Neither slept.

An enemy patrol scattered in front of S-F1. Leopold Fwtx fired at the last man to run. Marek "Lucky" Rezasiibiil was gravely wounded. Leopold Fwtx was cleaning the rifle when a head showed across the wire. Load, aim, fire. Gideon Samuelbujore was grazed.
gunny1717: Viktor Gunny came from Dunmarrow, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people. Viktor Gunny transferred to the machine gunners. The men in V-F22 said they would miss him. He is only three dugouts away. Viktor Gunny bought War Bonds for the front. The quartermaster pinned the ribbon on personally: 'The front remembers who kept it fed.' Viktor Gunny was invited to the Officers' Mess for keeping the front supplied. The colonel poured a real coffee and raised his cup: 'The front does not forget its friends.' A Jack Russell terrier wandered in from no man's land at dawn, wet and hungry. It chose Viktor Gunny. Viktor Gunny gave it a name: Tess.
rayan.zulfi: Pavel "Lucky" Zulfi signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at R-F9 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.

Someone had labelled the water bucket 'Soup'. Pavel "Lucky" Zulfi changed it back after lunch, too late to settle the argument. News of the loss of Verdel Ridge reached R-F9 with the rations. Pavel "Lucky" Zulfi ate while listening to the revised orders.

The barrage caught Pavel "Lucky" Zulfi in the open at R-F9. The medic tied two tourniquets and shouted for a bed. The shell that hit R-F9 took Pavel "Lucky" Zulfi with it. No stretcher, no surgeon, no last words. Just the crater.
Felix Zulfi had heard about Pavel "Lucky" Zulfi's courage. At R-F9, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
Felix Zulfi was peppered by shell splinters at R-F9. A medic picked them out one by one while the next salvo came in.

Felix Zulfi no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt. The Hegemony took Hill 304, and the orders at R-F9 changed before the cheering ended. Felix Zulfi shouldered another load.
A bullet clipped Felix Zulfi's helmet at R-F9 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Jonas Steini of the Concord (@steini10.02).
The medics cleaned Felix Zulfi's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at R-F9.
At R-F9 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Felix Zulfi won the bet. Ivo "Ash" Superfeisty was gravely wounded.

Felix Zulfi rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Severin Samhatespeac was grazed at the far edge of no man's land. A dummy head on a stick drew the enemy's eye at R-F9. Felix Zulfi saw where the answering shot came from and fired back. Edmund Crack was grazed.

Felix Zulfi was on the dawn watch at R-F9 when the Concord raiders came. A club, a shout, and Felix Zulfi was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Viktor "Button" Chasserant of the Concord (@axel_chasserant). Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Felix Zulfi watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

Three days with a bandage, and Felix Zulfi is back at R-F9. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him. Felix Zulfi got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 111. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Felix Zulfi helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
Felix Zulfi let three easy targets go by. The fourth was the one worth the risk. Severin Samhatespeac was gravely wounded.
Felix Zulfi had watched a loose sandbag in the enemy wall for two days. This morning it moved. Hugo Rock was grazed.
Someone asked Felix Zulfi to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten.
Felix Zulfi waited for someone in the enemy trench to lift a pair of field glasses. Rafael Real did, and was badly wounded.
rob98smith: Clement Smith came up on Day 14 carrying news from Coldwater. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.
The new recruit kept closing both eyes to aim. Clement Smith spent the afternoon helping until one eye stayed open.
rsaldana5897: The old hands of U-F4 have been here since Day 1. Marek "Shadow" Rsaldana has been here since Day 11. In a trench, that difference already feels like years. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at U-F4 changed before the cheering ended. Marek "Shadow" Rsaldana shouldered another load.
Marek "Shadow" Rsaldana fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Emil "Whistle" Knekt was gravely wounded. Marek "Shadow" Rsaldana ate breakfast without a word.
There is a sniper across the way the men call the Widow. Three helmets went up on sticks today. the Widow hit all three. Marek "Shadow" Rsaldana watched where the shots came from.
Marek "Shadow" Rsaldana and Felix Mply made a pact: whoever gets home first visits the other's mother. They shook on it twice, to be sure.
Marek "Shadow" Rsaldana lay in the ruins of Hill 304 all day. the Widow did not fire once. Neither did Marek "Shadow" Rsaldana. Both of them know.
sgt.nuggets: Florian Nuggets reported to R-C6 with a bullet that missed him sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.

A bullet clipped Florian Nuggets's helmet at R-C6 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Severin Masterofecli of the Concord (@masterofeclipse). Florian Nuggets walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Florian Nuggets returned to R-C6 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Florian Nuggets answered to number 654. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Florian Nuggets during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Florian Nuggets checked the duty roster and noticed the same names on the worst shifts. He fetched a fresh sheet of paper and started over.
Florian Nuggets had orders to attack at dawn. He wrote back asking for artillery first. The orders were cancelled. Nobody knows which of his words did it.
Florian Nuggets tried to dry a page near the stove. The paper survived, but the message now has the smell of toasted bread.
Florian Nuggets remembered the tune but not the words. Six men offered six different songs, and none of them helped.
slevvinkilevra: Day 9: Nils "Saint" Slevvinkilev reached Q-F17 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached Q-F17 with the rations. Nils "Saint" Slevvinkilev ate while listening to the revised orders.

Nils "Saint" Slevvinkilev fired one burst and pulled the gun down before the reply came. The reply hit empty sandbags. Ulrich Bear did not get to reply at all, grazed. After the loss of Grey Mill, Nils "Saint" Slevvinkilev helped stack spare sandbags at Q-F17. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Nils "Saint" Slevvinkilev sharpened a pencil carefully and then could not think what to write. He put the date at the top anyway.
Henrik Jjheals and Nils "Saint" Slevvinkilev have a secret signal: two taps on the helmet means 'still here'. They use it every night after the flares go out.
The water jacket hissed as Nils "Saint" Slevvinkilev fired across no man's land. When the gun went quiet, Clement "Bones" Bear was grazed.
Nils "Saint" Slevvinkilev fired a burst, moved the gun ten yards, and fired again before the enemy could reply. Viktor Adamsapple was badly wounded.
steini10.02: Jonas Steini told the sergeant he was a medical student. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed more rain, and put him on sentry.

Jonas Steini raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F7. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Benedikt Ngaihte of the Hegemony (@mng.ngaihte). Verdel Ridge fell to the Concord at dusk. Jonas Steini helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Jonas Steini is whole again, or near enough for the line.
Jonas Steini and Matthias Mart argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war.

Jonas Steini fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Leopold Shadowizard, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything. Hill 304 is in Hegemony hands. Jonas Steini stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
A clear shot from R-F7. Jonas Steini grazed Felix Zulfi and slid back down below the parapet.

Felix Serreno of the Hegemony threw a tin of tobacco into the Concord trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Jonas Steini kept the tin. A letter from home found Jonas Steini before the night shift. Jonas Steini folded it small and kept it close. Jonas Steini's transfer to the role of sniper was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.

A bullet went through Jonas Steini's upper arm at R-F7 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Dorian Yoollyfox of the Hegemony (@yoollyfox). A dummy head on a stick drew the enemy's eye at R-F7. Jonas Steini saw where the answering shot came from and fired back. Ivo "Bones" Rylan was gravely wounded. A letter from home found Jonas Steini before the night shift. Jonas Steini folded it small and kept it close.

Jonas Steini lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk. A letter from home found Jonas Steini before the night shift. Jonas Steini folded it small and kept it close.

Jonas Steini returned to R-F7 thinner and paler, with a wound that closed without a single night in a bed. The medics count it as one of theirs. Blackwater Canal is lost. Jonas Steini heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race. A letter from home found Jonas Steini before the night shift. Jonas Steini folded it small and kept it close.

A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Jonas Steini shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Marek Izu, was gravely wounded. A letter from home found Jonas Steini before the night shift. Jonas Steini folded it small and kept it close. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Jonas Steini answered to number 142. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Jonas Steini watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Jonas Steini's ear at R-F7 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Henrik "Shadow" Chauhan of the Hegemony (@prithvirajs.chauhan). A letter from home found Jonas Steini before the night shift. Jonas Steini folded it small and kept it close.
Jonas Steini's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it. A letter from home found Jonas Steini before the night shift. Jonas Steini folded it small and kept it close.

Jonas Steini lost at cards to the corporal and now owes him a week of tobacco and one favour, unspecified. A letter from home found Jonas Steini before the night shift. Jonas Steini folded it small and kept it close.

Jonas Steini reads Dietrich Veryprdy's letters from home out loud, because Dietrich never learned to read. Jonas leaves out the sad parts. Dietrich knows. A letter from home found Jonas Steini before the night shift. Jonas Steini folded it small and kept it close.
the_devonshiretommy1885_1945: The new machine gunner is Oskar Devonshireto, once a tailor from Brennmoor. The corporal asked if a tailor was any use in a trench. Oskar Devonshireto said he would find out.
Blackwater Canal is lost. Oskar Devonshireto heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Oskar Devonshireto woke with his hair frozen to the sandbags. The cook brought tea so hot it hurt. Nobody complained. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Oskar Devonshireto looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
A bullet grazed Oskar Devonshireto's ribs at S-R17. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Casimir "Whistle" Chrisoostuiz of the Hegemony (@chrisoostuizen).
The medic looked at Oskar Devonshireto's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to S-R17. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.
Oskar Devonshireto found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases.
A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Oskar Devonshireto. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer.
thebaconnation: Zeno Thebaconnati reported to T-F20 with a child's drawing of a horse sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Zeno Thebaconnati wrote to an old father who runs the family shop alone that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Zeno Thebaconnati smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Cyril Schaefer came out for a cup and was grazed. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into T-F20. Zeno Thebaconnati has learned to walk bent double.
A borrowed pencil wore down while Zeno Thebaconnati was writing home. The last line is twice as large as the first.
Zeno Thebaconnati and Ulrich Mercenary made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it.
Zeno Thebaconnati did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Zeno Thebaconnati fired back. Cyril Schaefer was grazed.
Zeno Thebaconnati fired at the enemy dawn watch from T-F20. Leopold "Saint" Ihatethis was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.
uwuandrea_: Tobias Uwuandrea told the sergeant he was a glassblower. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.

Tobias Uwuandrea made it into the enemy trench and out again, but a machine gun swept no man's land on the way home. Tobias Uwuandrea crawled the last yards. Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Tobias Uwuandrea could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

Three days with a bandage, and Tobias Uwuandrea is back at S-R13. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him. A letter from home found Tobias Uwuandrea before the night shift. Tobias Uwuandrea folded it small and kept it close. Orders assigned Tobias Uwuandrea to work as a chaplain. The first lesson began with what not to touch. Tobias Uwuandrea walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Tobias Uwuandrea was hit in the foot through his boot at S-R13. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Quentin Archiegregor of the Concord (@archiegregorysmith). The bearers reached Tobias Uwuandrea at S-R13 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Quentin Archiegregor of the Concord (@archiegregorysmith).
Arno Uwuandrea had heard about Tobias Uwuandrea's courage. At S-R13, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
The fog lifted at noon and Arno Uwuandrea saw Blackwater Canal clearly for the first time. He wished it had stayed.

Arno Uwuandrea went out with the wiring party at S-R13. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit. A letter from home found Arno Uwuandrea before the night shift. Arno Uwuandrea folded it small and kept it close.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Arno Uwuandrea in the open at S-R13. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Zeno "Rabbit" Adamgribac of the Concord (@adamgribac). Arno Uwuandrea stood up to fix a loose sandbag at S-R13. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Zeno "Rabbit" Adamgribac of the Concord (@adamgribac).
A letter came with Wendel "Tin" Uwuandrea: "I am Arno Uwuandrea's cousin. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
zicharyafournier: Marek "Tin" Zicharyafour walked into R-R11 on Day 9 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Marek "Tin" Zicharyafour wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Marek "Tin" Zicharyafour was hit in the forearm at R-R11. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Dorian "Whistle" Aversa of the Hegemony (@aariele_aversa). A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Marek "Tin" Zicharyafour is number 836. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Marek "Tin" Zicharyafour looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

Marek "Tin" Zicharyafour took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at R-R11, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Bram Wade of the Hegemony (@wade_b_p). Marek "Tin" Zicharyafour was killed at R-R11 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Bram Wade of the Hegemony (@wade_b_p).
A letter came with Quentin Zicharyafour: "I am Marek "Tin" Zicharyafour's uncle. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.

Quentin Zicharyafour had just lit a cigarette at R-R11 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Anselm Ryan of the Hegemony (@superb.ryan).
Quentin Zicharyafour returned to R-R11 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part.
